title: Plasticizer mixture exposure-induced preeclampsia pathogenesis: Integrated single-cell and bulk transcriptomics, network toxicology, and molecular docking insights.
authors: Zu, Chenwan; Li, Min; Ren, Sen; Chen, Niuniu; Ye, Lan; Guo, Rui
journal: Food and chemical toxicology : an international journal published for the British Industrial Biological Research Association
one_liner_zh: 该研究利用转录组、网络毒理学和分子对接探讨增塑剂暴露与子痫前期发病机制，虽涉及分子对接但核心是毒理学与疾病机制，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: PURPOSE: While plasticizers are known preeclampsia (PE) risk factors, the mechanisms of combined exposure to ATBC, DEP, DMP, and DOP remain unclear. This study aims to elucidate their biological targets and pathogenic mechanisms in PE. METHODS: PE/toxin gene targets were predicted from databases. Biomarkers were identified via differential expression analysis, machine learning, expression verification, and ROC analysis. GSEA, immune infiltration analysis, molecular dynamics simulation, and scRNA-seq elucidated mechanisms and cell subsets. RT-qPCR and IHC validated target expression. PRINCIPAL RESULTS: We identitified three key targets (BCL6, FLT1, and INHA) enriched in the ribosome pathway and correlated with activated dendritic cells (p < 0.01). Compared with other targets, FLT1 exhibited the lowest binding energies with DEP, DMP, and DOP, all of which were </=5.8 kcal/mol. The scRNA-seq analysis identified villous cytotrophoblast (VCT) as a key cell type with dynamic expression of BCL6 and FLT1 during differentiation. RT-qPCR and IHC confirmed the upregulation of BCL6, FLT1, and INHA in PE placental tissues, and their differential expression in VCT cells between the control and experimental groups. MAJOR CONCLUSION: The findings clarify plasticizer toxicity and provide novel insights into PE pathogenesis, offering a theoretical basis for improved clinical treatments.
abstract_zh: 目的：虽然已知增塑剂是子痫前期（PE）的风险因素，但ATBC、DEP、DMP和DOP联合暴露的机制仍不清楚。本研究旨在阐明它们在PE中的生物学靶点和致病机制。方法：从数据库中预测PE/毒素基因靶点。通过差异表达分析、机器学习、表达验证和ROC分析识别生物标志物。GSEA、免疫浸润分析、分子动力学模拟和scRNA-seq阐明了机制和细胞亚群。RT-qPCR和IHC验证了靶点表达。主要结果：我们识别了三个关键靶点（BCL6、FLT1和INHA），它们富集于核糖体通路，并与活化树突状细胞相关（p < 0.01）。与其他靶点相比，FLT1与DEP、DMP和DOP的结合能最低，均≤5.8 kcal/mol。scRNA-seq分析确定绒毛细胞滋养层（VCT）为关键细胞类型，在分化过程中BCL6和FLT1表达动态变化。RT-qPCR和IHC证实了PE胎盘组织中BCL6、FLT1和INHA的上调，以及它们在对照组和实验组VCT细胞中的差异表达。主要结论：这些发现阐明了增塑剂的毒性，并为PE发病机制提供了新见解，为改进临床治疗提供了理论基础。
